pending.title: Strand-Specific RNA-seq
pending.summary: A kit-agnostic dUTP workflow for building strand-specific Illumina RNA-seq libraries from total RNA, with QC and strandedness checks. The second cDNA strand is marked with uracil and removed before PCR so that read orientation reflects the transcript strand.
pending.keywords: strand-specific RNA-seq dUTP directional library UDG USER poly(A) rRNA depletion Illumina infer_experiment strandedness

sources.citation: Parkhomchuk D, Borodina T, Amstislavskiy V, et al. Transcriptome analysis by strand-specific sequencing of complementary DNA. Nucleic Acids Res. 2009;37(18):e123.
New England Biolabs. NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina, instruction manual (E7760/E7765).

Levin JZ, Yassour M, Adiconis X, et al. Comprehensive comparative analysis of strand-specific RNA sequencing methods. Nat Methods. 2010. Summary page: Broad Institute, RNA-seq: Comparing strand-specific RNA sequencing techniques.

pending.title: Lactate Dehydrogenase (LDH) Assay
pending.summary: Two complementary LDH methods: a kinetic NADH-based activity assay read at 340 nm, and a colorimetric LDH-release cytotoxicity assay read at 490 nm. Includes unit calculations, % cytotoxicity and controls.
pending.keywords: LDH lactate dehydrogenase NADH 340 nm cytotoxicity assay LDH release Triton X-100 diaphorase INT tetrazolium 490 nm enzyme activity units
